fact: A Banco de Cabo Verde aviso on payment accounts applies to payment service providers and e-money issuers duly authorised by the Banco de Cabo Verde under Decreto-Legislativo 9/2018, setting rules for opening, managing and closing payment accounts.
title: Boletim Oficial (Aviso: regras para abertura de contas de pagamento)
